### Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always
frustrated when [...]

### Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

### Describe alternatives you've considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Pi parity?

Does Pi (the TypeScript upstream) have this feature? If yes, link to the
relevant issue or commit. nini tracks Pi's behavior, so parity-first
features are usually easier to land.

### Use case

Describe your concrete use case. The more specific, the better — "I want
to be able to do X when Y happens" rather than "this would be nice".

### Willingness to contribute

- [ ] I would implement this myself with a maintainer's guidance
- [ ] I would submit a PR for this if the design is agreed on
- [ ] I would only file this issue and not implement it

### Alternatives

If Pi doesn't have this and you'd be open to a different design, what
existing nini feature could be extended to cover your use case?
